reusedProof.description: Campaign I independent authenticated remote report readback,65579bytes exactSHA256; not repeated.

additionalBoundedFact.scope: Retained local Library identity metadata only; no fresh remote version-history attestation. Prior remote read version_id:null does not prove absence of Library versioning.

existingDocumentedMechanisms.fact: Replacement can carry expected_current_version; concrete versions must come from retained provider metadata. Version conflicts require read/reconcile, not guard removal.
Explicit restore_version accepts existing Library item/version; exact historical bytes must be independently compared if that operation is required. Normal file deletion moves to trash.

Current surfaced read/list/search/replace/restore capabilities provide object handling, but no retention-policy or runtime-principal ACL audit endpoint was exposed. Lack of surfaced endpoint is not account-wide feature absence.

exactRemainingAssuranceDependencies.missing: A complete consistent runtime DATA snapshot, not a checkpoint report or inspection-only archive, bound to source, writer topology, snapshot digest, stores, Redis chronology, sessions, journals and pending work.
exactRemainingAssuranceDependencies.shortestAction: Use shared recovery campaign once its complete capture is proven; retain a single canonical set in the existing authorized route.

exactRemainingAssuranceDependencies.missing: Applicable retention/protection arrangement for that actual backup object, together with returned object/version identity and retained digest/history sufficient for original contract. Current local version0 and report hash do not establish retention horizon or retained historical versions.
exactRemainingAssuranceDependencies.shortestAction: Read existing owner-visible object/version/retention controls or provide actual provider/owner custody record; do not purchase a new service or invent WORM requirements.

exactRemainingAssuranceDependencies.missing: Bounded evidence that declared application/worker/controller principals, including their credential or proxy/mount paths, cannot overwrite/delete the protected copy. Owner connector authentication is not this negative-access proof.
exactRemainingAssuranceDependencies.shortestAction: Inspect secret-free runtime access policy/capability summary and perform an authorized bounded denial check against the actual custody object or equivalent control boundary; no secret values needed.

exactRemainingAssuranceDependencies.missing: Exact independent authenticated readback of the complete set, corrupted-copy refusal and good-copy fresh-target application restoration with original sessions, financial/mission integrity, once-only pending continuity and inactive execution authority.
exactRemainingAssuranceDependencies.shortestAction: Join this to the same shared recovery examination; do not create separate expensive campaigns per requirement.
